|strategy=By [mailto:briank@decipher.com Brain Kallenbach]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20010329183318/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/momawnadon.html</ref>

Momaw is, somewhat surprisingly, one of the better characters in the game, with an ability of 3 for a relative low deploy cost. His real advantage, though, comes from his spy ability. He is one of the more common Light Side spies, along with [[Wyron Serper]] and [[Commander Vanden Willard]]. Theses three together can make good use of the [[Undercover]] card, while not resorting to owning massive amounts of cards. Combos: [[Momaw Nadon]] vs. Rancors -- The biggest, baddest creature in the game can quickly switch sides with Momaw around. The trick, though, is to have Momaw follow [[Malakili]] around, so that the [[Rancor]] doesn't eat Momaw as he tries to snare it. Despite the almost random selection process for a creature's attack, owning a creature does have its advantages, such as choice of movement. Sending a [[Wampa]] back to the farthest markers to keep it away from Echo Base is never a bad idea.
